warn_paragraph_match: Paragraph mapping did not match ({n} hits): {match}
warn_note_match: Note did not match a sentence ({n} hits): {match}
warn_lang_missing: Language file {lang} not found; using English
md_finalized: **The user clicked “Finalize”**: this version is final. Make the final small edits from the annotations below, if any, and finalize; no further version.
md_orphans: ## Old annotations that no longer match the draft
load_failed: Loading failed: {err}. Make sure the server is running.
copy_title: Copy the plain text of the draft to the clipboard
finalize_title: Finalize this version; no further version
sent_missing: (this sentence is not in the current draft)
para_missing: (this paragraph is not in the current draft)
banner_changed_since: The draft changed after the last annotations, so some annotations may not match the current sentences; each annotation still keeps the original text it was made on.
banner_diff: Compared with the previous version {base}: {changed} sentences changed, {new} added, {deleted} deleted. Green marks additions and red strikethrough marks deletions; turn off “Show changes” in the top bar to hide them.
banner_submitted: Submitted at {time}. Further annotations are saved automatically, and you can submit again when needed.
status_save_failed: Save failed: the server is not running or has exited
or_own: or write your own view below
comment_placeholder: What is wrong, why, and how you want it changed (⌘+Enter to save)
general_label: Apply from now on (the agent turns it into a writing rule; unchecked means fix only this place)
overview_help: Click a sentence to annotate it; click “Annotate paragraph” to annotate a whole paragraph; click “Note on the whole document” in the top bar for comments on the whole draft. Annotations are saved automatically: click “Submit” when you are done, or “Finalize” if this version is good. You can select text to copy it; “Copy all” in the top bar copies the whole draft.
questions_heading: Decisions the agent needs from you ({n})
doc_notes_help: To answer a question on the whole document, click “Agree with the suggestion”, or click “Note on the whole document” in the top bar and write your view.
confirm_finalize_with: This version has {n} annotations. After you finalize, the agent makes the final small edits from them and finalizes directly, with no further version. Finalize?
confirm_finalize_empty: Finalize this version? The agent will treat it as final.
confirm_submit: {n} annotations{open}. After you submit, the agent reads them and turns them into changes or writing rules. Submit?
after_exit_finalize: The server has shut down; the agent will be notified and finish the finalization. You can close this page.
after_exit_submit: The server has shut down; the agent will be notified and read the annotations for the next version. You can close this page; annotations made from now on will not be saved.
after_running: The server is still running, so you can keep annotating; click {what} again when needed.
modal_fail_body:
Reason: {err}.
The annotations are still on this page, so do not refresh or close it yet. Make sure the server is running (start review_server.py in a terminal), then click {btn} again.
